ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution is approximately 92% low-intensity (black) and 8% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels, with the highest contrast localized at the distal tips and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white mottling and high-intensity focal spots located at [X:0-50, Y:0-100] (left tip) and [X:900-1000, Y:0-120] (right tip); isolated white speckling distributed across the medial dark field; faint horizontal white banding along the right trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, thin white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing both lobes, with a higher density of multi-directional marks on the left lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged traumatic notch/missing tissue section is present on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately 150 pixels right of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, near-vertical high-contrast linear scar is visible extending upwards from the base of the fluke onto the lower-medial section of the right lobe.
